name: Shofu Inc.
summary: Shofu Inc. manufactures and sells dental materials and equipment worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Dental Business, Nail Care Business, Other Businesses. Its products include CAD/CAM materials, artificial teeth, porcelain, impression material, cement, primer, temporary sealant, wax, dental resin, dental crown resin, room temperature curing resin and flooring resin, metal, plaster and investment material, grinding and polishing material, root canal treatment equipment, dental models, medical equipment and machines, technician instruments/machines, books and patient handbooks, self-care products for patients, sanitary equipment, whitening, orthodontic, and other products.…
